g.text: covers anything below one second. Source: cap_20260920_111416/112321/112821/113321.pcap (4 files, 17.2 min; two continuous blocks of 192 s and 842 s).

g.text: One-way byte convention; loopback and non-IP traffic are handled per the data-convention note. Time-based statements are limited to those two blocks.
